beats.action: the courier pedals a bicycle along the wet harbour road past the moored fishing boats
the courier swerves around a stack of fishing crates on the slippery quay
the courier rides hard up the narrow lane between the shuttered shops

cast.descriptor: a young man with short brown hair and a lean build wearing a yellow rain jacket and grey trousers
an old man with a shaved head and a calm face wearing a saffron robe and wooden sandals

locations.setting: The setting is a rainy harbour town in modern Japan, wet cobblestones underfoot, fishing boats behind, under grey afternoon light.
The setting is a hilltop temple gate in modern Japan, worn stone steps underfoot, pine trees behind, under warm sunset light.

logline: A courier carries a sealed letter through a rainy harbour town and delivers it at the temple gate.
narrative: A courier carries a sealed letter across a rainy harbour town.
title: The Sealed Letter
